Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as oil, yields crank up pressure ahead of Fed rate move
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as oil prices reached $109.35 a barrel and the 10-year Treasury yield crossed 5%. These rising costs increased inflation concerns ahead of the Federal Reserve's expected interest rate hike.

Markets.title: Oil jumps over $3 as Saudi export halt, Libya outages stoke supply fears
Markets.summary: Oil prices rose by more than $3 after Saudi Arabia suspended shipments at Yanbu and Libya halted production at three fields. Supply fears intensified due to reduced traffic through the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing energy infrastructure attacks in Russia and Ukraine.

Markets.title: ICICI Prudential MF, Kotak MF top buyers in SS Retail's Rs 146 crore anchor round before IPO
Markets.summary: SS Retail raised 146 crore rupees from anchor investors, led by domestic mutual funds like ICICI Prudential MF and Kotak MF, ahead of its IPO on September 16. The multi-brand electronics and mobile phone retailer is managing the offering with Anand Rathi Advisors and Emkay Global Financial Services.

Markets.title: US 10-year Treasury yields hit 19-year high ahead of Fed rate decision
Markets.summary: US 10-year Treasury yields rose to a 19-year high on Tuesday amid climbing oil prices and global inflation pressures. Investors expect the Federal Reserve to soon raise interest rates to address these ongoing economic concerns.

Markets.title: Prashant Jain’s 3P India among anchors as Hero Motors raises Rs 300 crore ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Hero Motors raised Rs 300 crore from anchor investors, including Prashant Jain’s 3P India, ahead of its Rs 1,000 crore IPO. The automotive technology firm will use the proceeds for debt repayment, capital expenditure, and acquisitions.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets dropped over 1 percent on Tuesday due to rising oil prices, higher bond yields, and foreign outflows. The Nifty fell below its 23,231 support level while the vast majority of NSE stocks declined.

Geo-Political.title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
Geo-Political.summary: All supporting acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore was removed from the lineup following pro-Palestinian statements on stage. Sheeran stated he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped.

Geo-Political.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
Geo-Political.summary: Denmark's prime minister accused Russia of reckless behavior after a Russian warship fired flares at a Danish military helicopter. The Kremlin has not yet commented on the incident.

Geo-Political.title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
Geo-Political.summary: The United States may have developed a space-based weapon system. This announcement highlights the emergence of modern warfare in Earth's orbit.

Geo-Political.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
Geo-Political.summary: South African authorities are investigating whether the recent discovery of multiple women's bodies near Johannesburg is linked to a serial killer. President Cyril Ramaphosa has promised that justice will be served regarding these deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
Geo-Political.summary: Two sailors are missing after an oil tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. Oman stated that Iran claimed the ship hit mines, while the U.S. stated it was struck by a missile and a drone.

Geo-Political.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
Geo-Political.summary: A Pentagon inspector confirmed that US munitions shortages have resulted from the war in Iran. The inspector also found resupply bottlenecks, contradicting President Donald Trump's claims of limitless US supplies.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates the growing importance of AI optimization (AIO) compared to traditional search engine optimization (SEO) for organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and simplify their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: India needs to raise its game, the private sector must invest more: CEA
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that the Indian government will maintain growth-supportive policies, macroeconomic stability, and deregulation. He emphasized that India needs to improve its economic performance and urged the private sector to increase investments.

Data & Insights.title: Why can no one win a trade war? WTO warns tariffs and trade blocs could hurt everyone
Data & Insights.summary: The World Trade Organization warns that tariffs, trade barriers, and geopolitical blocs will weaken global trade and economic growth. This fragmentation of the global economy means that no country can emerge victorious from a trade war.

Data & Insights.title: India’s gold appetite cools? Govt data shows imports plunge 57.7% as exports surge 26.12 %
Data & Insights.summary: India's gold imports dropped by 57.7% to $2.3 billion in August, despite a 14.1% increase in overall imports. During the same month, the country's exports surged by 26.1%.

Data & Insights.title: Export surge, lower gold imports narrow August trade deficit
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise exports surged 26.12% year-on-year to $43.81 billion in August. Meanwhile, imports grew 14% to $70.67 billion, driven by lower gold imports which helped narrow the overall trade deficit.

Data & Insights.title: Sugar to eggs: A domino effect cooking in El Niño heat
Data & Insights.summary: A record-breaking El Niño has reduced sugar output and raised prices, creating a supply chain shock that is expected to increase ethanol production costs. This disruption could ultimately lead to higher prices for chicken and eggs.

Data & Insights.title: Why reducing govt debt matters for India even when it’s lower than advanced economies
Data & Insights.summary: India must reduce its public debt to maintain investor trust, despite having lower debt levels than advanced economies. This is necessary due to the country's high interest-to-revenue burden and strict market expectations for emerging markets.

India.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay's London Event Cancelled Over Safety Concerns
India.summary: The Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's upcoming event in London has been cancelled. A member of the Chief Minister's team stated that the decision was made due to public safety concerns.

India.title: 'Trinamool Is Liability For Bypoll': Congress Leaves Mamata Banerjee On Seen
India.summary: Reports indicate that West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee recently reached out to Congress General Secretary KC Venugopal with a proposal for an alliance ahead of upcoming bypolls. However, the Congress party reportedly ignored the outreach and did not respond to her offer.

India.title: Fuel Payment, Phone Purchase, Restaurant Bills: UPI Charges Explained
India.summary: Customers using UPI for purchases and peer-to-peer transfers are not charged any fees for these transactions. This applies to everyday payments such as fuel, phone purchases, and restaurant bills.

India.title: Mumbai's Iconic Cafe Mondegar Loses Licence Over Food Safety, Hygiene Lapses
India.summary: Mumbai's historic Cafe Mondegar in Colaba lost its operating license following food safety inspections on Saturday. The inspections revealed serious deficiencies in the cafe's hygiene and safety standards.

India.title: Explosion In Bengal's Rejinagar Ahead Of Bypolls, Cops Recover Bombs
India.summary: An explosion occurred in Bengal's Rejinagar area near Naopukuria late in the evening ahead of upcoming bypolls. Police subsequently searched the area and recovered bombs following reports of the blast.

India.title: AIUDF Chief Badruddin Ajmal To Contest Lok Sabha Bypoll From Assam's Nagaon
India.summary: AIUDF chief Badruddin Ajmal will contest the Lok Sabha bypoll from Assam's Nagaon constituency. The party chose its leader for the race instead of its earlier indicated nominee, Rezaul Karim Sarkar.

General.title: Baby 'cot cams' plan after inquiry finds Lucy Letby crimes could have been prevented
General.summary: Following an inquiry into Lucy Letby's crimes, plans are being developed to urgently introduce live-streaming cameras for baby cots. The report concluded that her murders and attempted murders could have been prevented.

General.title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
General.summary: All support acts quit Ed Sheeran's US tour following Macklemore's removal from the line-up. Sheeran stated he was not responsible for dropping Macklemore after the rapper made pro-Palestinian stage statements.

General.title: Dan Thomas resigns as Reform Wales leader after arrest on suspicion of assault
General.summary: Dan Thomas has resigned as the leader of Reform Wales following his arrest by Gwent Police on suspicion of assault. Thomas stated that he has done nothing wrong.

General.title: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling admits dangerous driving on motorway before crash
General.summary: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling has admitted to driving dangerously on a motorway. The admission follows a crash in May where he drove a Lamborghini into motorway barriers.
